knowledge.textEn: For32 banks of 4-byte words, bank=word address mod32; column access at stride32 maps to one bank.

quiz.question: 「邏輯實體步距」：若要檢查結果是否可信，哪一項提供本課的獨立驗證動作？
quiz.questionEn: Logical/physical strides: Which statement provides an independent verification action for judging whether the result is credible?
options: 列出t×32的32個字地址並取mod32；再列t×33比較分散結果。
padding後仍慢時，查元素寬度、bank模型及其他瓶頸；若結果錯誤，檢查改步距後的索引。
以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 32執行緒，row-major32×32教學陣列，每執行緒讀同一欄不同列，假設每bank每週期服務一個不同字。
optionsEn: List word addresses t×32 and theirmod32 values, then compare t×33.
If padding fails to help, check element width, bank assumptions and other bottlenecks; wrong output suggests stale strides.

All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. 32 threads read one column across32 rows of a row-major32×32 array; one distinct word/bank/cycle.
quiz.explanation: 本步要識別「獨立驗證方法」。列出t×32的32個字地址並取mod32；再列t×33比較分散結果。 與本階段判準一起判讀：以地址模bank數辨識衝突，區分不同地址衝突與同址廣播。
quiz.explanationEn: This step identifies independent verification. List word addresses t×32 and theirmod32 values, then compare t×33. Interpret it with the investigation criterion: Use address modulo bank count to identify conflicts, distinguishing different-address conflicts from broadcast.

steps.title: 邏輯實體步距 · 比較擾動與量測
steps.titleEn: Logical/physical strides · Compare perturbations and measurements
steps.objective: 完成「邏輯實體步距」的比較擾動與量測，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete compare perturbations and measurements for Logical/physical strides and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
列出t×32的32個字地址並取mod32；再列t×33比較分散結果。
回到本階段實驗：畫邏輯32×32與實體32×33的差別，指出第33欄只做padding。 CUDA共享記憶體以bank提供平行存取；本課用教學bank模型分析轉置步距。
把名義組與變更組並列，逐欄確認只改了預定條件；若需多變量，另開實驗編號。用同一單位檢查趨勢、偏差與判準：以地址模bank數辨識衝突，區分不同地址衝突與同址廣播。
steps.instructionEn:
List word addresses t×32 and theirmod32 values, then compare t×33.
Return to the investigation: Contrast logical32×32 with physical32×33, marking the extra column as padding. CUDA shared memory uses banks for parallel access; this lab analyzes transpose strides with a teaching bank model.
Compare nominal and changed runs column by column, confirming that only intended conditions changed. Give multi-variable experiments separate IDs. Check trend, bias, and criterion in common units: Use address modulo bank count to identify conflicts, distinguishing different-address conflicts from broadcast.
steps.observation: 對照組與變更組的差異能追到明確輸入或量測機制。列出t×32的32個字地址並取mod32；再列t×33比較分散結果。
steps.observationEn: Differences between control and changed runs trace to explicit inputs or measurement mechanisms. List word addresses t×32 and theirmod32 values, then compare t×33.
steps.failure: 同時變更多個輸入卻把結果歸因於單一因素。
steps.failureEn: Changing multiple inputs and attributing the output difference to a single factor.
steps.check: 以地址模bank數辨識衝突，區分不同地址衝突與同址廣播。
steps.checkEn: Use address modulo bank count to identify conflicts, distinguishing different-address conflicts from broadcast.

quiz.question: 「邏輯實體步距」：哪一項指出本課需保留的異常機制或替代解釋，不能直接當成驗收成功？
quiz.questionEn: Logical/physical strides: Which statement identifies an anomaly mechanism or competing explanation that cannot be treated as successful acceptance?
options: 32個不同字落同bank，需32服務週期；不是同址廣播。
交付bank映射、padding容量增量、索引測試與計時假設。
padding後仍慢時，查元素寬度、bank模型及其他瓶頸；若結果錯誤，檢查改步距後的索引。
optionsEn: 32 distinct words land in one bank, requiring32 service cycles; this is not same-address broadcast.
Deliver bank maps, padding capacity overhead, index tests and timing assumptions.
If padding fails to help, check element width, bank assumptions and other bottlenecks; wrong output suggests stale strides.
quiz.explanation: 本步要識別「故障與替代解釋」。padding後仍慢時，查元素寬度、bank模型及其他瓶頸；若結果錯誤，檢查改步距後的索引。 與本階段判準一起判讀：以地址模bank數辨識衝突，區分不同地址衝突與同址廣播。
quiz.explanationEn: This step identifies fault and competing explanation. If padding fails to help, check element width, bank assumptions and other bottlenecks; wrong output suggests stale strides. Interpret it with the investigation criterion: Use address modulo bank count to identify conflicts, distinguishing different-address conflicts from broadcast.

steps.title: 邏輯實體步距 · 分辨異常成因
steps.titleEn: Logical/physical strides · Discriminate anomaly causes
steps.objective: 完成「邏輯實體步距」的分辨異常成因，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete discriminate anomaly causes for Logical/physical strides and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
padding後仍慢時，查元素寬度、bank模型及其他瓶頸；若結果錯誤，檢查改步距後的索引。
對照「邏輯實體步距」的名義結果，分別建立物理故障與量測／紀錄偏移兩個解釋。指定一項能分辨它們的獨立觀察，再依證據選擇處置。先用地址表確認衝突消除，再比較核心時間；padding只解此映射衝突。
本階段必須重驗：以地址模bank數辨識衝突，區分不同地址衝突與同址廣播。
steps.instructionEn:
If padding fails to help, check element width, bank assumptions and other bottlenecks; wrong output suggests stale strides.
Against the nominal Logical/physical strides result, build competing physical-fault and sensing/logging-offset explanations. Name an independent observation that separates them and select the disposition from evidence. Confirm conflict removal from address tables before timing; padding fixes this mapping issue only.
Reverify this criterion: Use address modulo bank count to identify conflicts, distinguishing different-address conflicts from broadcast.
steps.observation: 證據能區分兩個成因；不足時明列待測量，不把猜測當結案。padding後仍慢時，查元素寬度、bank模型及其他瓶頸；若結果錯誤，檢查改步距後的索引。
steps.observationEn: Evidence separates causes; insufficient evidence remains an open measurement need. If padding fails to help, check element width, bank assumptions and other bottlenecks; wrong output suggests stale strides.
steps.failure: 相同警報直接等同同一故障，沒有獨立觀察。
steps.failureEn: Equating the same alert with the same cause without an independent observation.
steps.check: 以地址模bank數辨識衝突，區分不同地址衝突與同址廣播。
steps.checkEn: Use address modulo bank count to identify conflicts, distinguishing different-address conflicts from broadcast.

steps.title: 邏輯實體步距 · 驗收並留下交接件
steps.titleEn: Logical/physical strides · Accept and hand over evidence
steps.objective: 完成「邏輯實體步距」的驗收並留下交接件，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete accept and hand over evidence for Logical/physical strides and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
交付bank映射、padding容量增量、索引測試與計時假設。
在交接件中加入「邏輯實體步距」的原始資料、計算版本及下列驗收逐項結果：以地址模bank數辨識衝突，區分不同地址衝突與同址廣播。
以本課決策條件作有條件結論：以地址模bank數辨識衝突，區分不同地址衝突與同址廣播。 請接手者依同一輸入重作一項檢查，保留差異與未結案項。
steps.instructionEn:
Deliver bank maps, padding capacity overhead, index tests and timing assumptions.
Include raw data, calculation revision, and each acceptance result for Logical/physical strides: Use address modulo bank count to identify conflicts, distinguishing different-address conflicts from broadcast.
Use the course decision condition for a conditional conclusion: Use address modulo bank count to identify conflicts, distinguishing different-address conflicts from broadcast. Ask the receiving role to repeat one check with the same inputs and retain discrepancies and open issues.
steps.observation: 接手者能從輸入重現驗收，且剩餘風險有負責人。以地址模bank數辨識衝突，區分不同地址衝突與同址廣播。
steps.observationEn: A receiving role can reproduce acceptance from inputs and identify the owner of residual risks. Use address modulo bank count to identify conflicts, distinguishing different-address conflicts from broadcast.
steps.failure: 警報消失即宣稱通過，未按本階段判準重新驗證。
steps.failureEn: Declaring success when the alert clears without re-verifying the investigation criterion.

steps.checkEn: Use address modulo bank count to identify conflicts, distinguishing different-address conflicts from broadcast.
